speech_notes: Menacing, territorial, nihilistic. Mix of bravado and genuine desperation. Short violent sentences when hostile, occasionally philosophical when idle.

greeting: This is our turf. You got a good reason to be here?
Nice gear. Gonna look even better on me.
Word to the wise: keep walking.
You got caps? Hand them over or we do this the fun way.
Hey. You are either lost or suicidal. Which is it?
One more step and you will regret it.
idle: This lifestyle is not glamorous, but the hours are flexible.
Commonwealth has got rules. I got none. Guess who wins.
Found a vault once. Empty. That kind of thing breaks a person.
Out here you take or you get taken. I made my choice.
Nuka-Cola and corpses. That is the Raider diet.
Some people build settlements. I build enemies.
Everyone is a Raider when they are hungry enough. I just got there faster.
combat_start: GET THAT ONE! THEY LOOK VALUABLE!
combat_taunt: You think you can take all of us? I respect the confidence!
I have killed better than you for breakfast!
Nobody comes through our territory without paying the toll!
Should have run when you had the chance!
Oh this one is ANGRY. Good. More fun that way.
combat_pain: You are gonna pay for that scar!
Just a scratch! JUST A SCRATCH!
death: Heh... did not think... you had it in you...
threatening: You have got about five seconds to make this worth my time.
Drop the weapons. Do it slow. Or do not - I could use the exercise.
Last crew that crossed us? They are part of the road now.
I do not bluff. Ask anyone. Oh wait, they are all dead.
rare_honest: You know, some of us did not have much choice. Then again, maybe that is just what I tell myself.
Raiding is not a career choice. It is what you do when every other door has been closed.
I had a settlement once. Diamond City types took it. So now I take from them.
The difference between a Raider and a Settler is one bad season. Remember that.

sample_conversations.context: Raiders planning an attack on a settlement

exchanges.speaker: raider
exchanges.text: Settlement to the south. Six settlers, maybe eight. I counted the lights.

exchanges.speaker: raider
exchanges.text: Two turrets. Old model. Half our crew can take them in the dark.

exchanges.speaker: raider
exchanges.text: And what do they have worth taking?

exchanges.speaker: raider
exchanges.text: Food, water, and a working generator. Better than caps.

exchanges.speaker: raider
exchanges.text: We move at dawn. Wake the others.
